newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free-mkt wheat, barley, intervention rye.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free-mkt wheat, barley, intervention rye.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted licences to export 273,500 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum rebate of 11.47 Ecus per tonne, an EU grain official said.

The official confirmed the EU granted licences for the export of 301,000 tonnes of free-market barley at a maximum rebate of 28.47 Ecus per tonne and 10,000 tonnes of free-market rye at a rebate of 34.98 Ecus per tonne.
He also said the EU granted licences to export 1,400 tonnes of free-market oats to Switzerland at a maximum rebate of 26.94 Ecus per tonne.
The grains management committee also sold 52,460 tonnes of German intervention rye at a minimum price of 94.58 Ecus per tonne for export to non-EU countries, member state officials said.
There were no other intervention awards.
